notes.title: Overlooked roguelike RoGlass just got a free update, and deserves more players
notes.content:
Not every roguelike needs to focus on action. I love darting around arenas and turning bad guys into paste, but the replayability of the genre lends itself to so many unique ideas that I'm always on the hunt for what developers are coming up with next. That's why I've been keeping an eye on RoGlass, which pins its focus on a puzzle-like mechanic that gets infinitely more engaging as you play. More people need to try it, and the latest update and sale is the perfect time.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Excellent roguelike RoGlass finally hits Steam 1.0, you need to try it
Puzzle roguelite RoGlass is Balatro with tiles, and you can try it now

notes.title: Challenge Modes
notes.content:
[h1]CHALLENGE MODES[/h1]
[h3]NEW END GAME CONTENT[/h3]
It's taken a while, but I'm happy to announce that challenge modes and 20 new achievements are now in the game! Once you've beaten the game for the first time, you'll have access to challenge modes via a button in the bottom right (above restart).

[h3]Putting more "Rogue" in RoGlass[/h3]
Complete various achievements in this meta version of RoGlass and get as far as you can in each mode. Challenge modes have special modifiers that twist the rules of the game, so you'll have to think differently about how you play. Start from the beginning with a limited number of restarts, but keep various upgrades from meta achievements that you earn.

[h1]Five new ways to play[/h1]
Challenge modes change the base game of RoGlass in a way that will make you think differently about how to score points, earn achievements, and place tiles! Here's a brief summary of each:

[h3]Basic Challenge[/h3]
Play through RoGlass with a limited number of restarts and see how far you can get. Unlock achievements to reveal additional challenge modes.

[h3]Unlimited Tiles Challenge[/h3]
Place as many tiles as you have space for! However, you have very few restarts, so you'll have to be clever about how you plan to get various achievements with only a few rounds.

[h3]Low Score Challenge[/h3]
Waste not, want not! In this challenge, you'll start with many more restarts, but lose them as you score points.

[h3]Always Rolling Challenge[/h3]
The supply rerolls when you place a tile. Use this excess of RNG to your advantage and decide what tile is most valuable moment to moment.

[h3]Adjacency Challenge[/h3]
Tiles must be placed adjacent to each other (the first tile can be placed anywhere each round). Work your way through achievements by planning ahead!

I hope you enjoy these new twists to RoGlass as many of you have been looking for more reasons to keep playing. Thank you so much for the support!

Side note: If you have reset your progress, you should still have access to the new challenge modes right away, and if you ever do a full reset, you can start challenge modes without having to play the base game all the way through again.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Quality of Life Update is Here![/h1]
Thanks for supporting RoGlass and me as a developer! As a token of appreciation, I've been hard at work since the 1.0 launch to get some quality of life changes into the game as quickly as possible. 

[h2]Gameplay Changes, Less RNG![/h2]
[list]
[*]Players are now given 2 rerolls instead of 1 when unlocking them.
[*]Players are now given 4 reroll locks instead of 2 when unlocking them.
[*]Hitting the restart button now has a greatly increased chance to give tiles not shown in the supply. This should minimize spamming the restart button to receive tiles that you're looking for.
[*]The power of "Big Combo" upgrades reducing the RNG when rerolling is now more effective for the first few upgrades (and relatively the same when fully upgraded).
[*]There is now a option to automatically rotate through the game's soundtrack by clicking the music button at the bottom left.
[*]Players can now pan the camera by click and dragging the right or middle mouse buttons.
[*]Players can press "R" to restart a round without having to click the restart button.
[*]Right clicking while holding a tile will now drop the tile back into the supply (unless you have the pointer upgrade that utilizes right click and are holding a pointer).
[*]The tutorial now appears after doing a data reset.
[/list]
[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The tile supply is now greyed out when you run out of tiles, and colorful again if you gain the ability to place more tiles that round.
[*]There are many more resolution options now available.
[*]You can now shrink the restart button's widget by clicking the arrow icon next to it, freeing up more screen space.
[*]The close button for various pop up menus is now red and stands out more.
[*]The music button icon looks much more musical and has 3 different visual states for playing one song, rotating through all songs, and being muted.
[*]Changed the wording of the "Share the Warmth" achievement to better represent its objective.
[*]The exit game button is now larger and closer to the rest of the settings, making it easier to find.
[*]Changed "Ultra" to "Best" in the visual quality settings so there is less confusion on what option is the best.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed players to hold onto a tile while restarting.
[*]Fixed an issue that awarded players extra points to total score when restarting (this was fixed in the demo but snuck back into the full version).
[*]Fixed an issue where starting resolution would show up as 0x0 (I'm not sure if this is fixed since I couldn't reproduce it myself, but I believe I found the cause).
[*]Language selection should now carry over when doing a full data reset.
[*]Fixed an issue where fully resetting data twice in a row would reset audio volume to default.
[/list]
[h2]Future Content Update?[/h2]
As a completionist myself, I'm so happy to hear that many of you have 100%d the game and are looking for more. I've got some ideas on what new content to add to RoGlass, so look forward to a future update. My goal is to add new content onto the end of the game after completing it. What I have in mind is going to take quite a bit of time and experimentation, so please be patient while I figure things out. Thanks again for supporting me and my game, you all are awesome!

notes.title: Early access Update #19
notes.content:
[h2][b]Achievement Progress[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Missing achievements from the demo are now granted on opening the game!
[*] The "Refresh Achievements" button is still there in case Steam doesn't grant an achievement during normal gameplay
[/list]

If you haven't gotten the update, you may need to right click RoGlass in your library, click on "Properties", click "Installed Files", and then click "Verify integrity of game files." Another alternative is reinstalling the game.
